import sys
import argparse
import sirf.STIR as pet
import sirf.Utilities as ut

def osm_map_osl_reconstruction(
    image, objective_function, prior, image_filter, num_subsets, num_subiterations
):
    recon = pet.OSMAPOSLReconstructor()
    recon.set_objective_function(objective_function)
    if prior is not None:
        recon.set_prior(prior)
    if image_filter is not None:
        recon.set_image_data_processor(image_filter)
    recon.set_num_subsets(num_subsets)
    recon.set_num_subiterations(num_subiterations)
    recon.set_input(image)
    recon.set_up(image)
    recon.process()
    return recon.get_output()

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="User-defined OSMAPOSL reconstruction using SIRF."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--raw_data_file", type=str, required=True, help="Raw data file name"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--data_path", type=str, required=True, help="Path to data files"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--num_subsets", type=int, default=12, help="Number of subsets"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--num_subiterations", type=int, default=2, help="Number of sub-iterations"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--engine", type=str, default="STIR", help="Reconstruction engine"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--no_plot", action="store_true", help="Disable plotting"
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    try:
        ut.set_verbose(False)
        # Set up acquisition data
        acq_data = pet.AcquisitionData(args.data_path + '/' + args.raw_data_file)

        # Set up acquisition model
        if args.engine.upper() == "STIR":
            acq_model = pet.AcquisitionModelUsingRayTracingMatrix()
        elif args.engine.upper() == "PARALLELPROJ":
            acq_model = pet.AcquisitionModelUsingParallelproj()
        elif args.engine.upper() == "NIFTYPET":
            acq_model = pet.AcquisitionModelUsingNiftyPET()
        else:
            print(f"Unknown engine: {args.engine}")
            sys.exit(1)
        acq_model.set_up(acq_data, acq_data.create_uniform_image(1.0))

        # Initial image estimate
        image = acq_data.create_uniform_image(1.0)

        # Optional: set up a filter (e.g., Gaussian)
        image_filter = pet.SeparableGaussianImageFilter()
        image_filter.set_fwhms([3.0, 3.0, 3.0])

        # Set up prior (optional, e.g., QuadraticPrior)
        prior = pet.QuadraticPrior()
        prior.set_penalisation_factor(0.01)

        # Set up objective function
        obj_fun = pet.PoissonLogLikelihoodWithLinearModelForMeanAndProjData()
        obj_fun.set_acquisition_model(acq_model)
        obj_fun.set_acquisition_data(acq_data)

        # Run reconstruction
        recon_image = osm_map_osl_reconstruction(
            image, obj_fun, prior, image_filter, args.num_subsets, args.num_subiterations
        )

        # Show result
        if not args.no_plot:
            recon_array = recon_image.as_array()
            ut.show_2D_array(recon_array[recon_array.shape[0] // 2, :, :],
                             title="Reconstructed image (central slice)")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
